sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, AVG(yt) as avg_yt FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 80 AND fish_date_season = 2 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_doy, fish_date_t FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 2 ORDER BY fish_date_t DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT ts_doy, AVG(wtmp_c) as avg_temp_c, MIN(wtmp_c) as min_temp, MAX(wtmp_c) as max_temp FROM pier WHERE ts_season = 2 GROUP BY ts_doy ORDER BY ts_doy DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_boat FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 1 AND fish_date_doy >= 274 AND fish_date_doy <= 310 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy;

SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_boat FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 1 AND fish_date_doy >= 92 AND fish_date_doy <= 121 GROUP BY fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy;
